coverage_rule: Family PASS requires every applicable significant boundary to have accepted actual evidence or explicit sourced supersession/exclusion. Rows overlap; no feature denominator is inferred. Newly changed critical tests need red-before/equivalent mutation sensitivity. Source-only/existing-test references never runtime PASS.
source_fragment_policy: Concise semantic paraphrases of independently opened linked fragments, not literal quotations. Findings quote decisive originals.
execution_status: NOT_RUN: all proposed executable boundary rows remain UNKNOWN; existing and proposed test names are execution candidates only.
minimal_check_policy: One sufficient actual check per distinct invariant and implementation boundary; add real transport/browser/lifecycle evidence where mocks cannot exercise it. No exhaustive Cartesian product.
